subject.title: fix(gateway): bound TLS cert/key file reads with size limit

question: Should Gateway TLS preserve documented `caPath` CA-bundle support with a distinct, larger bounded limit before this hardening lands?
rationale: The repository documentation promises CA-bundle/custom-chain support, while the appropriate maximum bundle size is a compatibility and operational policy choice that cannot be inferred from the certificate/key limit alone.

options.title: Use a separate CA-bundle cap
options.body: Keep the 64 KiB certificate/key limit, choose and test a larger bounded `caPath` limit that supports documented CA bundles.

options.title: Adopt a 64 KiB CA contract
options.body: Keep one cap only if maintainers intentionally narrow `caPath`, update public documentation, and accept startup failures for larger existing bundles.

recommendation.title: Use a separate CA-bundle cap
recommendation.body: Keep the 64 KiB certificate/key limit, choose and test a larger bounded `caPath` limit that supports documented CA bundles.

likelyOwner.reason: The required choice balances core Gateway hardening against the documented TLS configuration contract.
